rooms.name: Lift & Stair Lobby
rooms.notes: Central core lobby serving 2 lifts and 1 stair in the circular tower core. Fire-rated lobby per NBC Part 4.

rooms.name: Office Reception
rooms.notes: Welcoming reception for office tenants on floor 1; glass curtain-wall exposure gives brand visibility.

rooms.name: Perimeter Corridor
rooms.notes: Circular perimeter circulation corridor wrapping the central core; width ≥ 1.8 m per NBC office egress norms.

rooms.name: Open-Plan Office Zone A
rooms.notes: Primary open-plan workspace; north-west quadrant of floor plate. 5 sqm/person per CPWD DSR. Full glass façade maximises daylighting per sustainable design brief.

rooms.name: Open-Plan Office Zone B
rooms.notes: Secondary open-plan workspace; south-east quadrant. Flexible demountable partitioning per IS 14660.

rooms.name: Cabin Offices
rooms.notes: Three enclosed private cabins (~15 sqm each) for senior staff; acoustic partitions.

rooms.name: Meeting Room
rooms.notes: Large boardroom-style meeting room; acoustic treatment; AV provisions; seats 14-16 persons.

rooms.name: Office Pantry
rooms.notes: Kitchenette with sink, microwave provision, and storage; serves entire floor. NBC hygiene separation from washrooms maintained.

rooms.name: Male Washroom
rooms.notes: Male WC block — 2 WCs + 2 urinals + 2 WHBs per NBC Part 9 Sec 1 (office occupancy). Core-side placement away from curtain wall.

rooms.name: Female Washroom
rooms.notes: Female WC block — 3 WCs + 2 WHBs per NBC Part 9 Sec 1. Core-side placement. Accessible cubicle included per NBC disability norms.

rooms.name: IT / Services Store
rooms.notes: Lockable store for IT equipment, stationery, and MEP access; fire-rated door.

response.floor_summary: Floor 1 is the first dedicated office workspace level of the circular mixed-use tower, comprising open-plan and cabin offices, a boardroom, reception, pantry, and compliant washroom facilities arranged around a central core with perimeter circular circulation corridor.
